## File: facebookresearch_parlai/parlai/agents/bert_classifier/bert_classifier.py

Prompts

```
['build a BERT classifier model with custom linear and relu classifier layers', 'create a BERT classifier agent that uses pretrained BERT embeddings for utterance classification', 'score a batch of text vectors using the BERT classifier model with segment indexing', 'customize classifier layers with linear and relu dimensions for the BERT classifier', 'configure the BERT classifier history to add SEP tokens between utterances']
```

Usage

```
{'build_bert_classifier_model': 'build a BERT classifier model with custom linear and relu classifier layers', 'create_bert_classifier_agent': 'create a BERT classifier agent that uses pretrained BERT embeddings for utterance classification', 'score_batch_with_bert': 'score a batch of text vectors using the BERT classifier model with segment indexing', 'customize_classifier_layers': 'customize classifier layers with linear and relu dimensions for the BERT classifier', 'configure_bert_history': 'configure the BERT classifier history to add SEP tokens between utterances'}
```
